s.t:
We are looking for a colleague to join Genoray’s German subsidiary in Berlin.
Genoray manufactures medical and dental X-ray equipment. Our products are distributed globally through our headquarters in South Korea, five overseas subsidiaries (Germany, USA, Japan, Türkiye and Shanghai), and more than 40 international partners.
As the European subsidiary, we operate in a B2B model, supplying our products to local distributors across more than 20 countries, including Germany, the UK, Spain and Italy. Our goal is to strengthen our presence in the European market by ensuring high customer satisfaction, making service a key part of our success and of your role with us.
As a Medical Equipment and Device Field Technician/Engineer, you will be responsible for supporting medical (C-arms and mammography systems) and dental (OPG, CBCT, and portable) product lines.
Our work contributes to safer diagnostics and better patient care. We value a collaborative environment where colleagues support and inspire each other.
Tasks
Customer Service, Technical Support and Training: Provide technical support to distributors in Europe, including troubleshooting, problem resolution and general assistance for medical equipment. Perform installation, maintenance, repairs and technical inspections. Deliver training to customers and partners on proper equipment use and handling.
Business Travel and On-Site Service: Carry out service-related business trips within Europe and internationally, which include installations, repairs, inspections, and other technical service activities.
Logistics, Warehouse and Spare Parts Management: Handle goods receipt and dispatch processes, including unloading deliveries, safe storage of equipment, preparation and shipment of devices and parts, as well as coordination with transport providers. Manage spare parts inventory to ensure availability for service and customer needs.
Administrative and Service Operations: Prepare necessary sales and shipping documentation (e.g. Proforma Invoice, Commercial Invoice). Perform administrative tasks related to service operations, logistics and spare parts management.
Equipment Preparation and Exhibitions: Inspect, adapt and configure machines for shipment according to customer requirements, including technical adjustments where needed. Support installation and deinstallation of equipment at exhibitions and trade fairs.

Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical, Electrical, or Electronic Engineering, or a comparable degree or relevant practical experience
Professional experience is not required, but considered an advantage
Experience in customer service or technical support for medical equipment is preferred
Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Well-organized with a structured and solution-oriented mindset
Fluent English is required; German and/or Korean language skills are considered an advantage
Willingness to travel internationally on a regular basis with no travel restrictions
Valid work permit for Germany required

Being part of a globally leading and fast-growing medical and dental X-ray equipment manufacturing company
Company laptop and mobile phone provided
Exciting international working environment with partners across the globe
Flat organizational structure that encourages open communication and the contribution of your ideas
27 vacation days plus public holidays
Free coffee, tea, snacks, and other refreshments
Office located in the heart of Berlin
Job Start: As soon as possible (negotiable)
Job Type: Permanent, full-time
If you would like to join our team and support our mission to continue saving people through our work, please send your application with CV and Cover Letter to us.
For any further questions, please contact us.
We look forward to receiving your application!

Kemin Application Solutions is seeking a Service Engineer to join our team! This team is responsible for the design, maintenance, and support of the product application systems and services we provide to our customers.

The Service Engineer will perform routine equipment checks at customer sites, including pump calibrations, minor system repairs, and nozzle inspections and cleaning. Join the Kemin Team and Transform Lives!
We are a privately held, family-owned-and-operated global biotechnology company driven by curiosity and committed to transforming the quality of life for people, pets, and the planet.
We create solutions that strengthen health and wellbeing, provide nutrition and immune support for pets and production animals, safeguard the planet’s natural resources, and protect the global food supply chain for generations to come.

Our client - a leading food manufacturer based in Bendigo, is looking for 2 experienced Maintenance Fitters to join their team.

Sunday to Friday starting at 11pm on Sunday and ending at 7.30am on Friday.
A month of 7 on 7 off start time 6am to 6pm on, then rotates to night shift for a month, 6pm to 6am.

· Annualised $50-51 per hour paid bi-weekly, including penalties and loading
· Earn up to $150k with overtime
· Meal breaks paid
· Tools paid
· 5 weeks annual leave

The primary responsibilities of the Maintenance Fitters include disassembling and assembling pumps, diagnosing and resolving issues with pneumatics and hydraulics, and servicing and overhauling gearboxes. The role involves working with a variety of equipment, including Multivac, Mondini, and Dematic systems, as well as robots and Bosch vacuum pumps.

Preventive & Corrective Maintenance
Breakdown Response
Equipment Setup & Adjustments
Fault Finding & RCA Support
Safety & Compliance
Continuous Improvement
Documentation & Reporting
Team Support & Training

Candidates should possess strong mechanical skills and ideally have a background in food manufacturing, FMCG. The ability to think ahead and outside the box is crucial due to the high-pressure environment of food processing. Machining skills would be advantageous. While welding skills are a plus, they are not essential.

It is important for candidates to have experience with the disassembly, reassembly, and servicing of gearboxes, as well as diagnosing pneumatic and hydraulic systems. We are open to considering heavy vehicle or HD fitters, provided they have the core mechanical skills required.

s.h: Top Priorities in the First Six Months
s.t:
In the first six months, the priorities for the fitters will be mastering the disassembly and assembly of pumps, diagnosing and resolving issues with pneumatics and hydraulics, and effectively servicing and overhauling gearboxes. Success in these areas will be critical to minimizing downtime and maintaining production efficiency.

* **Spezialkonditionen bei Fahrzeugkauf und Service:** Für dich und deine Familie - weil wir wissen, wie wichtig Mobilität ist

* **Dienstleister- & Stakeholdermanagement:** Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für externe Dienstleister sowie interne Partner und sorgst für eine professionelle Zusammenarbeit. Qualität, Sicherheit, Termine und Kosten hast du dabei jederzeit im Blick
* **Prozessoptimierung & Betriebssicherheit:** Du bringst dein technisches Know-how aktiv ein, identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale und unterstützt bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer Gebäude- und Betriebstechnik. Zudem wirkst du bei Tests, Wartungen und sicherheitsrelevanten Massnahmen mit
* **Bau-, Sanierungs- & Infrastrukturprojekte:** Du unterstützt Bau-, Umbau- und Sanierungsprojekte aus technischer Sicht und stellst sicher, dass elektrotechnische Anforderungen berücksichtigt werden. Dabei koordinierst du interne und externe Partner und begleitest Projekte bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung
* **Standortorganisation & Services:** Du verantwortest die Zutritts- und Schlüsselverwaltung und unterstützt bei organisatorischen Aufgaben rund um den Standort. Zusätzlich hilfst du bei der Vorbereitung und Durchführung von internen Veranstaltungen und Events

* **Ausbildung:** Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Elektroinstallateur/in EFZ, Betriebselektriker/in, Elektroniker/in EFZ, Montage-Elektriker/in EFZ oder vergleichbare technische Grundausbildung
* **Fachliche Erfahrung:** Berufserfahrung im Bereich Elektroinstallationen, Betriebselektrik, Instandhaltung, Gebäudetechnik oder technischer Gebäudeunterhalt von Vorteil
* **Technisches Verständnis:** Du begeisterst dich für technische Anlagen und Infrastrukturen, arbeitest lösungsorientiert und packst gerne selbst mit an
* **Kommunikationsstärke:** Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie ein professioneller und dienstleistungsorientierter Umgang mit unterschiedlichen Anspruchsgruppen

Who we are
Apollo , a Skyward Group company, is an innovation-inspired insurance platform operating at Lloyd’s of London, delivering data-driven and creative solutions across a broad range of risks.
Our name reflects our origins. Inspired by one of our founding investors, Neil Armstrong, the first person to walk on the moon, the business was built with the same pioneering mindset. Alongside Jim Hays, Neil set out to create a different kind of Lloyd’s platform, focused, agile and built around people.
Since launch in 2009, we have grown into a diversified insurance group offering products across Property, Casualty, Marine, Energy and Transportation, Specialty and Reinsurance, alongside Smart Follow and digital and embedded risk programmes. Our experience and unique ecosystem give Platform Partners the best chance of success, from navigating the Lloyd’s new entrant process through to the delivery of their long-term strategy.
With a team of more than 300 professionals, we continue to grow with purpose, combining underwriting excellence, innovation and collaboration to enable a more resilient and sustainable world.

We are looking for a Senior Delegated Facilities Technician to support the effective oversight and performance of Apollo’s delegated facilities portfolio.
Working closely with underwriters and teams across the business, you will apply Apollo’s Third-Party Oversight Framework to help maintain regulatory compliance, strong customer outcomes and effective portfolio management. You will also provide technical guidance on delegated arrangements and contribute to the continued development of the team’s processes and expertise.

Provide technical guidance to underwriters on delegated facilities and third-party oversight.
Complete onboarding and ongoing due diligence for delegated authority arrangements, including Binding Authorities, Consortia, Line Slips and Master or Group Policies.
Support the sponsorship process for Lloyd’s approval across relevant territories.
Manage bordereaux and third-party data, ensuring accurate and timely reporting.
Coordinate annual audits, review audit reports and track recommendations through to completion.
Maintain delegated facilities information and records within Apollo’s management systems.
Support performance management processes, including premium income monitoring, product governance and internal audits.
Contribute to departmental projects and the Delegated Authority Oversight Group.
Work with internal teams including Underwriting, Claims, Finance, Pricing, Exposure Management and Compliance to resolve queries and improve outcomes.

Experience managing the Lloyd’s sponsorship and approval process across multiple territories, including the UK, North America and the EEA.
Strong knowledge of delegated authority oversight, due diligence, bordereaux management and audit management.
Good understanding of Lloyd’s systems, processes and regulatory expectations.
Experience using relevant Lloyd’s platforms such as Atlas, DCOM, DAM, Crystal or the Binding Authority QA Tool.
Confidence engaging with underwriters and a broad range of internal and external stakeholders.
A responsive and organised approach, with the ability to manage changing priorities and keep stakeholders informed.
Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to address underlying issues.
An interest in developing deeper technical expertise and contributing to the wider capability of the team.
What you’ll get in return
We offer a competitive and thoughtfully designed reward package that reflects the value of our people. This includes a fair and attractive salary, discretionary bonus, and a comprehensive benefits package - including 31 days’ annual leave, a non-contributory pension and private medical insurance.
Our commitment to inclusion
At Apollo, people are at the heart of everything we do. We are a diverse, growing team of empowered experts who bring collaboration, innovation and data-driven thinking to every relationship and every risk.
We believe diversity and inclusion go far beyond targets. They are essential to understanding the global communities we serve and to making better decisions. That’s why we are committed to developing diverse talent at every level and creating an environment where different perspectives are genuinely valued, supported and celebrated.
We also run a programme of events, training and initiatives designed to recognise both the challenges and opportunities that come with building an inclusive workplace.
Hybrid & flexible working
Flexible and hybrid working are fully embraced at Apollo. We do not believe in presenteeism. Instead, we trust our people to work in ways that allow them to perform at their best, balancing professional responsibilities with personal commitments.
